content.comment_body: Hello, I have experience with [product_name] V6 modules and am considering a switch to the [product_name] V8 series. I have a few questions: Is it possible to program the [product_name] V8 using the same programming cable currently used for [product_name] V6 modules? I need an extension module with 4 inputs and 4 relay outputs. The catalog lists it under [article_no], but I cannot locate this article number anywhere. Could this be a typo, or is the module unavailable? Also, is it possible to use extension modules from [product_name] V6 ([article_no]) with [product_name] V8? Thank you, [user_name], Canada

Your programming cable is only compatible with [product_name] versions up to [version_no] and older. Starting from [version_no] or later, programming requires a standard Ethernet cable. The expansion module with order number [article_no] does not exist; you likely meant [article_no] instead. For [product_name] V8 with 4 inputs and 4 relay outputs, suitable modules include: - [article_no]: [product_name] expansion module, SV / E / A: 24V / 24V / relay, 4 DE / 4 DA. - [article_no]: [product_name] expansion module, SV / E / A: 12, 24V / 12V / 24V / Relay, 4 DE / 4 DA. - [article_no]: [product_name] expansion module, SV / E / A: 230V / 230V / relay, 4 DE / 4 DA. The [product_name] V8 system and its expansion modules are new hardware and cannot be used together with extension modules from earlier versions such as [version_no] or older. Expansion modules for [product_name] V8 have [article_no] at the end of the order number. Any modules ending with [article_no] or [article_no] are not compatible with [product_name] V8. Conversely, modules ending with [article_no] cannot be used with older hardware.

analysis.insight_summary: Users moving from older hardware versions to newer ones are unsure about compatibility of programming cables and extension modules. Responses clarify that equipment from earlier versions, including cables and modules, generally do not work with newer hardware, and help correct confusion over ordering information and product codes. Providing precise guidance on product transition and identification of parts is crucial for users upgrading to newer modules.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate backward compatibility for programming cables and extension modules, as well as clear information regarding ordering and identification of required parts for the new hardware versions. Simplified identification and ordering of product codes are also expected.
